name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v1505: Two things Konyo caught on the live v1504 window. The head row was over-full at his width - the tab strip ran into the clock and the clock into OFF AIR - because the strip was allowed to claim its content width and push its neighbours out instead of yielding; it can now shrink and scroll its own overflow while the clock and the ON OFF AIR control keep their space at any width. And the sigil was still showing konyo-3.local: a hostname is not a name and the Bonjour suffix is the least human part of it, so the domain is stripped and the naming invitation moved from the pill into the tooltip, which is also what had widened the pill in the first place.
